python_version.notes: Local .venv runs Python 3.13.15 64-bit on Windows 11, matching sandbox 3.13 specification.

swegemma.notes: Core SWE-bench harness, scoring engine, and two-container sandbox runner. Pre-installed in competition scoring image.

adk_submission.notes: Declarative agent compiler, sandbox security validator, and vLLM server manager. Pre-installed in competition scoring image.

adk_eval_core.notes: Evaluation data models, 3-tier string replacement engine, token/cost tracker, and ATIF v1.7 logger.

vllm.notes: vLLM serves gemma-4-31b-it-qat-w4a16-ct on 4x NVIDIA L4 GPUs in scoring container. Serving configuration is verified from HARNESS_README.md, but exact wheel and runtime version numbers are not provided in competition assets (previous 0.19.1 and 0.18.0 entries were unverified inferences).

features: Archive size limit check (< 3 GiB unpacked)
Path traversal security check (prevents directory breakout)
Single Base Model Rule enforcement across all agent trees
Required top-level keys validation (model, instruction, tools)

competition_harness_validator.notes: Official competition compiler invoked by runner inside scoring container. Not installed or executed on local Windows workstation.
